description: This file defines the SugarAuthenticate class which manages user authentication, session validation, password encoding, and related processes within the SuiteCRM project, a fork and extension of SugarCRM Community Edition. It contains methods for login, session management, multi-factor authentication, and logout functionality.

classes.name: SugarAuthenticate
classes.description: Class responsible for handling user authentication, session validation, multi-factor authentication, password management, and login/logout processes within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Loads the user authentication class based on existing file paths, allowing for override in custom directories.

methods.name: loginAuthenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user with given username and password, updates user preferences upon success, and manages login errors.

methods.name: postLoginAuthenticate
methods.description: Sets up user session preferences after successful login, including language and temporary file cleanup.

methods.name: sessionAuthenticate
methods.description: Ensures an active and valid session for the current user, including IP validation and session revalidation.

methods.name: postSessionAuthenticate
methods.description: Performs additional checks after session validation, including cross-site requests and multi-factor authentication.

methods.name: addFactorMessage
methods.description: Stores a message related to multi-factor authentication in the session for user feedback.

methods.name: getFactorMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and clears stored factor authentication messages from session.

methods.name: validateIP
methods.description: Validates that the client's IP address matches the session IP, to prevent hijacking.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Destroys the current session and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: encodePassword
methods.description: Encodes a given password using MD5 and converts to lowercase; static method.

methods.name: canChangePassword
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is allowed to change their password (returns true).

methods.name: canChangeUserName
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is allowed to change their username (returns true).

methods.name: pre_login
methods.description: Performs pre-login checks and redirects if a user session already exists.

methods.name: redirectToLogin
methods.description: Redirects the user to the login page using the provided application context.
